name: The Portfolio Project: From Brief to Deploy
summary: The thing you can show. Choosing a project that proves what the track taught, cutting it down until it ships, and finishing it — deployed, documented and explained in two minutes.
prerequisites: Requires the track you are on — this is where it gets used. The course is the same whichever track that is; what changes is what you build.
